title: Formal unramifiedness of a scheme stalk from maximal ideals and residue fields
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], let $x\in X$ and $s=f(x)$. Write $A=\mathcal O_{S,s}$ and $B=\mathcal O_{X,x}$, with the actual local ring homomorphism $f_x^\sharp:A\to B$, and let $\mathfrak m_A,\mathfrak m_B$ be their maximal ideals. The ring map $f_x^\sharp$ is formally unramified (for every $A$-algebra and square-zero ideal, two lifts agreeing modulo the ideal are equal) if and only if $\mathfrak m_A B=\mathfrak m_B$ and the induced residue-field extension $\kappa(x)/\kappa(s)$ [def-weil-residue-field] is finite separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension].
